jobDescription:
Be an Entrepreneur Manager • Own a Market

GTM Leader • US Market • Extensive US Travel


Locations: Bengaluru • Hyderabad • Gurugram • Pune • Chennai


About AIONOS

AIONOS (pronounced aye-yo-nos) is an AI-native technology company that builds and operates enterprise AI for industries. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Singapore, AIONOS is a joint venture between InterGlobe Enterprises and Assago Group, bringing together deep enterprise technology expertise and sector-defining operational experience. With live operations across the USA, UK, Europe, the Middle East, Japan, APAC, ANZ, and India, the company deploys a workforce of 2,500+ AI engineers, domain specialists, and practitioners across Aviation, Travel & Hospitality, Logistics, Telecom, BFSI, and Healthcare. Powered by its proprietary AI enterprise stack, AIONOS delivers measurable business outcomes through an accountable, human-in-the-loop model that sits on top of existing enterprise investments.


For more information, visit www.aionos.ai


Job Summary

Own origination, pipeline, and revenue across Global Capability Centers. You bring your own accounts, we add a named list, and you run pursuits end to end while advising clients on setting up, scaling, and transforming their GCCs. You will sell AIONOS's full service line: Strategy, Consulting, Technology, Data and AI, Cloud, SAP, Security.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own revenue for your accounts. Build qualified pipeline and grow wallet share.
  • Carry and deliver the number. Inside sales supports the top of the funnel, but attainment sits with you. Set account priorities, brief the inside sales executives, and source your own meetings where coverage falls short.
  • Run large pursuits spanning multiple service lines, from qualification through commercial negotiation and closure.
  • Map GCCs to their US parent companies to find warm entry points.
  • Represent AIONOS at GCC forums, industry events, and client roundtables, and feed market and competitive intelligence back into growth strategy.
  • Work across Client Groups, Industry teams, and Global Sales on integrated account strategies.

Must Have Skills

Experience

  • 7 to 10 years of enterprise technology consulting or sales experience, selling Digital, Cloud, Data and AI, or large transformation programmes into Travel, Transport, Logistics, BFSI, or Telecom clients.
  • A live rolodex inside existing GCCs in these verticals. You should be able to open doors in weeks, not quarters.
  • Deals run end to end: account mining, pipeline creation, CXO relationships, commercial negotiation.

Hunting and demand generation

  • Hardcore outbound to US and India enterprise buyers, including cold outreach and meetings you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through your prospecting method and how many connects became meetings.
  • Able to direct inside sales effort with sharp targeting, clear messaging, and tight follow up, while still picking up the phone yourself.
  • A quota you have carried and hit. Bring the target, the achievement, the percentage, and the period for your last two or three cycles. We will ask.

Thinking and initiative

  • Finds ways into accounts that others miss, and builds an offer around the client's real problem instead of a standard service pitch.
  • Works without being managed. Reads account data, org charts, and market signals to decide where to spend time, then tells a story good enough to get a meeting. We are screening for initiative and follow through, not credentials.

Travel

  • Roughly half the year in the US, on a cycle of 15 days in India followed by 15 days in the US. Valid passport required, US visa preferred.

Good to Have

  • Background at a Tier 1 consulting or systems integration firm.
  • Existing relationships with NASSCOM chapter heads or the GCC Council.
  • Experience managing strategic global accounts and complex pursuits with many stakeholders.
  • Sales certification covering the full sales motion from prospecting to closing. Salesforce Certified Agentforce Sales Foundations preferred. HubSpot Academy or LinkedIn Learning equivalents also relevant.

Education

Bachelor's degree required. MBA or PGDM from a premier institute preferred.

Area/Tower: Program Project Management
Purpose
The Program Project Management Services Manager is an execution-focused leadership role and at a level below the L3 Global Sub-Capability Head, Cluster Delivery Head of Program Project Services IN/PH/MY. The role contributes to the transformation of the Global Delivery Unit into the Future Mode of Operation (FMO) supporting large-scale adoption of automation, follow-the-sun delivery, AI techniques, and a one-standard approach across Global Delivery Centers, while ensuring quality and competitiveness at a GDC level.
The Program Project Management Services Manager is a GDC-based role with accountability within a single location. The role will be responsible for operationalizing and executing globally defined sub-capability strategies within the GDC-specific Program Project Management Servicesmanaged area / service and team. This includes optimizing service delivery, operational performance, and delivery execution within the agreed global framework defined by L3 leadership. While global strategy ownership remains with the Cluster Delivery Head of Program Project Services IN/PH/MY, decision authority of the Program Project Management Services Manager is focused on operational execution, prioritization, and delivery governance within a single location.
Key objectives:
  • Given the role has single-location accountability within one Global Delivery Center and country, execute and operationalize the globally defined sub-capability strategy and standards for the managed area / service and team within Program Project Management Services of PPS, aligned with the HITDWP Service Line strategy.
  • Manage and develop high-performing professionals within the Program Project Management Servicesmanaged area / service of dedicated location, collaborating with global and regional stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance and support to local team members within the managed area, fostering continuous learning while promoting diversity and an inclusive workplace.
  • Ensure effective and efficient delivery through strong people leadership, skills development, and implementation of global career pathways.
  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of services within the local managed area / service and team of GDC.
  • Drive continuous improvement and standardization across all managed services or teams within the GDC, aligned to expected outcomes such as standardization, effectiveness, efficiency, and roadmap delivery.
  • Identify opportunities for business growth and improved market competitiveness, tailored to the managed area.
  • Establish and oversee management reporting, review, and change-control processes.
  • Drive the adoption and effective use of Agile practices. Implement AI and automation solutions as defined by global standrads to enhance local delivery performance.
  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations, organisational and GDU policies, and incorporate ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles within the local GDC scope.
  • Manage delivery within agreed budgets and financial frameworks defined at sub-capability level, ensuring cost discipline and forecast accuracy.
  • Participate in the pre-sales process at local execution level, including cost-model development and approvals.
  • Continuously monitor and analyse market trends affecting the managed area / service and team of GDC to identify opportunities and challenges.
Qualifications:
  • Experience: Several years (at least 8) in the IT industry, and in a leadership or management role.
  • Significant experience in managed services operations, with a track record of implementing standardized processes and delivery excellence.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of Program Project Management Services related industry, including the latest trends, challenges, and opportunities.
  • Certifications: preferred, but non-mandatory certifications, i.e. ITIL, Agile, PM (PMI, Prince2, P3O, PgMP).
Competencies:
  • Operational Excellence: Knowledge of operational best practices in the Program Project Management Services within GDC, including process improvement, quality management, resource optimization, and performance metrics.
  • Strategic and Commercial Acumen: Ability to support and execute strategic plans for Program Project Management Servicesgrowth, improve service delivery, increase client satisfaction, and align operational goals with organizational strategy.
  • Financial Acumen: Understanding of financial management principles, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis. Ability to manage the profitability of managed area / service or team of GDC.
  • Leadership and Team Management: Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop high-performing teams. Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
  • Client Relationship Management: Experience in managing client relationships, understanding client needs, and delivering high-quality service.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with clients, team members, senior management, and diverse stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and teamwork within GDC.
  • Adaptability: Ability to adjust to rapidly changing environments while applying a problem-solving mindset to address people challenge.
  • Global and Cultural Awareness: Experience working in a global environment, collaborating with international clients of of managed area / service or team of GDC.
